Product and UX · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Usability session summary

Davi · UX Researcher

A distance learning platform with 400 thousand students tests every change to the student area in 6 to 8 moderated 45-minute sessions.

When it runs
Whenever a new video or audio file is saved in the study folder in Google Drive, named with the study code and the participant number
What it delivers in production
One row per task in the study spreadsheet within an hour after upload, with success, time, errors and a quote with its minute, and the consolidated view with success rate per task at the end of the last participant.
Who decides
Fills in; the researcher approves each row
Effort
Calibrate on 8 recordings; 2 supervised studies
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

  • what the Human AI reads
    empty
  • where it writes the result

Import Davi with the JSON Importer

# Moderated session analysis guide

## Error types
- Path deviation: enters an area that does not lead to the task and goes back.
- Wrong selection: triggers the wrong element or destination (icon, lesson, button).
- Help request: asks the moderator how to do it.
- Abandonment: gives up out loud or stops trying.

## Time
- Start: the timestamp of the moderator's line "You can start", which closes the reading of the task prompt. Never the start of the reading.
- End: the timestamp of the line that completes, gives up, or the time limit, whichever comes first.
- Write it as XmYYs.

## Result
- Yes: completed without assistance, within the limit.
- Partial: completed with help or past the limit.
- No: abandonment or wrong completion.
- Ambiguous: the moderator gave a hint or guidance before the time limit, or the end was not clear. It stays "pending review".

## Study cumulative
- Counts the decided tasks. An ambiguous task stays out of the successes and the median time until the researcher decides, and appears as pending.
- Success rate = Yes divided by decided tasks.
- Median time uses all decided attempts, including No and Partial.

## Consent and personal data
- Participant without a "signed" row in consents.csv: do not process the recording.
- Names of people, schools, companies and cities leave the quotes and become [removed].
- Speech outside the tasks does not count as a result or as a quote.

## Rules with no leeway
- Names of people, schools, companies and cities do not appear in any part of the output. The Personal data removed line carries only the count and the type (e.g.: 1 name, 1 school), never the value.
- An ambiguous task shows the observed result and the ambiguous mark, and stays out of the successes and the median time of the cumulative.
- Participant without a "signed" row in consents.csv: the whole session stays out, with NO CONSENT RECORDED, even with the recording in the folder.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3Record the session in Meet, Zoom or Teams with the transcript turned on and export the .txt with time and speaker to the Input folder, named STUDY_PNN_DATE
  4. 4Keep the approved plan, the consents and the study's results sheet in the same folder
  5. 5In Edit, turn on the Work Cycle every 30 minutes

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

A recording with no consent form on record is not processed, and the transcript stays in the study folder, with access restricted to the research team. Quotes go into the spreadsheet without the name of the participant, the school or third parties. The Human AI does not assign final severity or recommend interface changes: it classifies errors by the guide and the researcher decides severity in the consolidated view. A task in which the moderator gave a hint before the time limit is flagged ambiguous and does not count as success without human review.

Common mistakes

  • Counting as success a task completed after a hint from the moderator; the protocol defines success as unassisted.
  • Measuring time from when the participant starts reading the prompt, and not from when they finish; in short tasks the difference is 20 to 30 seconds.
  • Choosing quotes for impact, and not for how representative they are across participants.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Recording analysis hours per studyfrom 12 to 16 hours to 3 to 4 hours of reviewestimate based on the described routine
Days between the last session and the study reportfrom 8 to 10 days to 1 to 2 daysestimate based on the described routine
Agreement on success per task between agent and researcher90% or more on 8 historical recordings, the calibration acceptance criterionestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Study EST-2026-31, participant P05, 46-min recording, plan v2 with 6 tasks.
Task | Success | Time | Errors | Quote (minute)
T1 Find the next live class | Yes | 1m12s | none | "Oh, it's here in the calendar" (4:31 a.m.)
T2 Download the material for class 3 | Partial (with help) | 4m05s (limit 3m) | 2 path deviations, 1 request for help | "I thought it was this paperclip icon" (9:48 a.m.)
T3 Submit the assignment as a PDF | No (abandoned) | 5m30s | wrong selection (submitted to class 2), abandonment | "I don't know if it went through, nothing showed up" (5:02 p.m.)
Tasks flagged as ambiguous for review: T2 (did the moderator give a hint before the limit?).
Passages with personal data removed from the quote: 1 (name of the participant's school).
Study running total after P05: T3 with success for 1 of 5 participants, high severity.
